review.notes:
Lineage v0 and v1 (both SDK-043, 2002-03-29) predate the baseline version - upstream's GOAT cdb text is exactly v2 (SKE-017, Starter Deck: Kaiba Evolution, 2004-03) - so they are noted rather than recorded. Minor packet observation, not a conflict: modern_text_matches_version reports index 3 at ratio 0.9952 because the pinned cards.cdb text carries a CRLF between the '(This card is not treated as a "Puppet" card.)' note and the effect line where the Yugipedia clean text runs them together; no wording differs. That parenthetical arrived with the same OP21 printing and is a name-collision clarification, not part of the behavioural change.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Mysterious Puppeteer). No period ruling in the corpus settles a claimed difference, so the functional call stands unchanged (`unresolved` at both snapshots); the search is recorded in the check. Verdicts: [event] d1 unresolved at Edison, unresolved at Tengu.

effective.basis: TCG release of OP21-EN013 (OTS Tournament Pack 21), the printing that introduced the 'another monster' wording

event.historical_text: Each time you or your opponent Normal Summons or Flip Summons a monster, increase your Life Points by 500 points.
event.modern_text: (This card is not treated as a "Puppet" card.)If another monster is Normal or Flip Summoned: Gain 500 LP.
event.summary: Functional erratum: the trigger now requires ANOTHER monster to be Normal or Flip Summoned. The GOAT script omits the modern condition 'not eg:IsContains(e:GetHandler())' - upstream annotates it 'Triggers on its own summon' - so the era card gains 500 LP off its own Normal or Flip Summon as well as off any other player's; the OP21 text ('If another monster is Normal or Flip Summoned: Gain 500 LP') excludes itself.

rulings_check.difference: Era: Mysterious Puppeteer's own Normal Summon or Flip Summon also triggers its effect (you gain 500 Life Points for it too); modern (2023): the trigger needs another monster to be Normal or Flip Summoned, so it never triggers on its own Summon.
